facts.text: Dave's walk to school through New York
facts.why: Dave lives on Staten Island with his father, but no transcript line, plot summary or search result shows him walking to school past a bodega or eating a bacon and egg roll.
facts.fix: A Staten Island breakfast for Dave.

vibe.verdict: Comic shop snack bar with the narration line, costume order, Mister Bitey and the butterfly knife, though the food is still ordinary.

Swap "Bowling alley ice cream sundae" for "Hit-Girl's birthday sundae, butterfly knife on the side".
Swap "Bowling alley burger" for "Big Daddy's burger", with a note about training Mindy.
Swap the house slushie note for "Hit-Girl's purple wig, sipped slowly" and make the combo "Bazooka Combo".
